source_text: Held-out scoring labels are hit, fp, clean, partial, wrong_possible, expected_outside, expected_charity, ir_gap, pattern_gap, contested_stay, and inside_miss (an inside miss that still needs ir_gap or pattern_gap). A wrong-label possible_issue is wrong_possible, not a hit. Genetic fallacy, bulverism, ad hoc rescue, and special pleading count as inside a pilot only when that id is itself a pilot. Guilt by association is a pilot, so its own name counts; it does not count as ad hominem. Details and the eight-pilot N=398 numbers: idea_detection/E2E_SUMMARY.md.
